 Stephen Curry (knee) available Monday 
 by Chris Schommer | Warriors Correspondent | Mon, Nov 2nd 2026, 6:02pm EST 
 Stephen Curry (knee) is off of the injury report for the Golden State Warriors against the Phoenix Suns Monday according to Duane Rankin. ( Duane Rankin on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Curry is back in the lineup for head coach Steve Kerr after sitting out the first leg of back-to-back contests Sunday night, boosting a Golden State starting five against the Suns.
 Stephen Curry (knee) and Draymond Green (back) aren't on Warriors' injury report for tonight's game vs. Suns at Chase Center.
Curry and Green didn't play in first matchup the Suns won Oct. 24 in Phoenix.
Al Horford and Brandin Podziemski didn't play in that game either. Horford…
— Duane Rankin (@DuaneRankin) November 2, 2026
